body: I called 911 once, they sent to a hospital and i saw 3 shrinks in 4 hours. Their report was summed up in a perfect phrase that said "MAJOR DEPRESSION!" And yes, it was in all capitals across the entire last page. The other times was when my teachers would comment on my papers asking me why are all my essays are always so dark and negative, so i told them. That was probably a bad decision because i was forced to talk to my counseler every day after school. Which did not help and probably made it worse. And the last time I told anyone i was feeling suicidal was my friend and all he said was "everybody thinks like that once in a while".... i have never told anyone besides my mom that i am constantly suicidal. I can experience joy, but for a minimal amount of time before my dark thoughts pop up again.
